thread.title: Apple's stock exacts a more than 20-point toll on the Dow industrials ahead of of event - MarketWatch

author: Mark DeCambre
title: Apple's stock exacts a more than 20-point toll on the Dow industrials ahead of of event - MarketWatch
text: The Dow Jones Industrial Average was struggling to advance in early Wednesday trade, with shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.71% producing the stiffest headwind for the benchmark stock gauge. The Dow DJIA, +0.48% was flat at 25,970, but the index was being weighed by a 1.4%, or $3.21, drop in Apple. That slide would translate to a 22-point toll in the Dow. A $1 swing in any one of the Dow's 30 component equates to a 6.8-point swing in the price-weighted index. Apple is slated to host a product event at 1 p.m. Eastern Time, which will feature upgrades to its roster of consumer products, include the iPhone and the Apple Watch. Meanwhile, the S&P 500 index SPX, +0.00% was off 0.3% at 2,879, while the technology-and-internet laden Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, -0.56% was down 1.1% at 7,887.
